one_line: A personal problem line, the brand named at the turn, then a calm run of everyday moments in synced subtitles.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 wide static shot: a woman in glasses in a cream bed with a newborn and a book, yellow wall. Voiceover (transcript): she spent most of her maternity leave in bed. Small white subtitles: "את רוב חופשת" then "הלידה שלי".
q1_hook.why: A first-person confession and a voice from 0:00 name a feeling new mothers know (H4, K6), said and written at once (H6). "Until I met Lamer" at 0:03 promises a change (H5). The bed shot is static and wide and the person is not talking to the lens (against F6), and the subtitle is small.

beats.what: A woman in bed with a newborn and a book; subtitles "את רוב חופשת", "הלידה שלי", "העברתי במיטה"
A hand sets a cream pouch marked Lamer on a stone planter
beats.why: The brand enters at the turn

beats.what: A pram through an archway; a baby carried on a garden stair; "פתאום נהיו לי ידיים פנויות"
A woman dresses and puts the carrier on in a stone doorway; "רגוע ושלו לכל מקום"
beats.why: Shows how quick it is to put on

beats.what: Chores and coffee in a kitchen; she sits with a cup, the baby asleep; "ונרדם עליי בשניות"
beats.why: Everyday proof of free hands and a calm baby

beats.what: In a courtyard she lifts the baby, fastens the straps; "סטייל ברמות וכמובן בטיחותי", "עוד המלצה"
beats.why: The only close look at fit, in a few seconds

beats.what: She walks away with the baby and a pram; "על מוצר קטן שעשה בחיים שלי שינוי גדול"
beats.why: Closes on the opening line's sentence

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: none in the video. The caption lists three features and ends without a question or ask.
q2_flow.why: A problem, turn and result arc with a new location about every 2 to 4 s keeps 28 s moving (K2, R3). The ending completes the sentence begun in the first line (H5, R4). A new mother might send it to a friend who is pregnant (R5). The features appear only in the caption (R3).

q3_cta.what: None. No ask, link, code or price on screen, in the voice or in the caption. Voice (transcript): "עוד המלצה, מאימא לאימא". The caption names the brand's account: "המנשא של @lamer.babyboutique".
q3_cta.why: A viewer who wants the carrier is given no link, word or shop, only a tag in the caption, so interest cannot turn into action (against C6). The recommendation voice, "mother to mother", is trust, not an ask (S6).

q4_shown.what: A mother in bed 0:00-0:02; a Lamer pouch 0:02-0:03; a woman with a carrier and a pram 0:04-0:07; putting the carrier on 0:08-0:12 and 0:18-0:23; chores and coffee wearing it 0:13-0:17; walking away 0:24-0:27. No price or product close-up.
q4_shown.why: A before and after in first-person voice with a calm baby is a persuasive story (K2, S6). The carrier is small and far in wide shots, and its features are never shown close (against F4). The brand logo shows on the pouch and in one subtitle; otherwise the brand stays light (C7).

q5_edit.what: About 12 shots in 27.8 s (about 2.3 s each), straight cuts, mostly static wide shots matched to subtitle phrases; one-line or two-line subtitles change about every second. Voiceover throughout. Ends on a walk under an archway.
q5_edit.why: Cuts matched to the voice give a clean rhythm (E2, R3), and short subtitles synced to the speech work with sound off (E4, T1, T2). The wardrobe and location changes look staged, and nothing slows for a feature (R3). It stops on the last line (E8).

q6_topic.what: A new mother's recommendation of a baby carrier that freed her hands; it serves new parents who want to get out and do things with a baby.
q6_topic.why: A real new-parent concern, feeling stuck at home, with a warm, calm answer (K6, K1) told as a personal story with a turn (K2). The buying moment is the newborn period (K7). Claims such as "safe" and "orthopaedic" are stated, not shown (K4).

q7_filmed.what: Static wide shots at eye level in warm, soft light: a bed, stone archways, a stone doorway, a bright kitchen, a courtyard seat. A woman in several outfits, a baby and a pram; one close-up of a hand with a pouch.
q7_filmed.why: A propped phone with soft light gives a calm frame (E6), but multiple locations and outfits look like a commercial shoot, not a home phone video (against H8, F7). Wide shots make the product small (F4); a woman's and a baby's faces are on screen for much of it (S5).

q8_text.on_screen: Small white bold sans-serif subtitles, one or two short lines, centred about 27 to 35 percent down, inside the safe zone, changing about every second: "את רוב חופשת" (0:00), "העברתי במיטה" (0:02), "עד הרגע / שהכרתי את Lamer" (0:03), "פתאום נהיו לי / ידיים פנויות" (0:05), "בכיף ובנחת" (0:13), "סטייל ברמות / וכמובן בטיחותי" (0:20), "על מוצר קטן / שעשה בחיים שלי" (0:25), "שינוי גדול" (0:27). No headline card.
q8_text.caption: "החלום של כל אמא טרייה - שתי ידיים פנויות והיכולתי לקחת את הבייבי איתך לכל מקום - רגוע, קרוב, ונרדם בשניות." About 36 words: the promise, "המנשא של @lamer.babyboutique", three check-mark features. No hashtags, no ask. No Hebrew partnership word; the post data shows a paid-partnership label and a coauthor.
q8_text.why: Short key phrases in the safe zone, held about a second each, make it readable on mute (T1, T2, T4), and the first caption line is a clear promise (T7). But the brand name shows only once in subtitles, and nothing in the caption's words says it is a partnership (against T8, S7).

weak_points: No link, word or price; the carrier small and far in wide shots; features only in the caption; a staged, multi-outfit commercial look; faces of a woman and a baby on screen; no Hebrew partnership wording in the caption.
lumebook_takeaway: Open on one first-person problem line in synced subtitles, name LumeBook at the turn, then three short home vignettes with the book in hand. End with a comment word.
not_verified: Whether the woman is the account owner (the outfits and rooms change); whether the baby is hers; music (the voiceover runs throughout); the paid-partnership label (it is in the post data, not visible in the frames); price and link. Correction: the carrier is first seen on a person at 0:05, and the 0:02 pouch is a bag, not the carrier; the carrier is clear only at 0:16 and 0:18-0:23.
